topology.description: Two independent CDU zones, 17 racks each, no cross-tie/standby. One equivalent pump and two-fluid-volume HX per CDU; not a model of the actual internal three-pump arrangement. One energy valve + supply isolation + return isolation per rack; isolation is a zero-volume series element co-located with its branch fitting.

geometry.description: 22 x 14 x 4 m assumed room; generic construction shapes cloned from own Shinaide fixture; 0.85 m assumed rack pitch. All line lengths come from the common geometry compiler, not NV CAD.

thermal.description: One equivalent liquid load/thermal mass per rack; not an individual GPU/cold-plate identification. Uniform 10 kW/rack chosen only for solver tests.

primary_circuits.source_reference: tools/nv_mock_project.ts: assumed constant 5 kg/s at 20 C; 50 L mixed primary and secondary volumes. Not vendor data, NV telemetry or calibration.
